text:
4. 2. 9

Sampannasuttaṃ

1703. Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca: "indriyasampanno indriyasampanno"ti bhante vuccati, kittāvatā nu kho bhante, indriyasampanno hotīti? idha bhikkhu, bhikkhu saddhindriyaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ

Viriyindriyaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ

Satindriyaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ

Samādhindriyaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ

Paññindriyaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ. Ettāvatā kho bhikkhu, indriyasampanno hotīti.
